period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own full unaudited '1st Quarter Financial Statements 2026' single-page disclosure (a designed infographic-style PDF published on thepremierbankplc.com, not the annual-report-embedded BSEC evaluation table used for prior years) -- containing a full Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Statement of Changes in Equity and Cash Flow Statement, all headed 'Consolidated'. *** BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, continuing the established mismatch against this dataset's Solo/Bank-Total Q4/annual series (2025_Q4.json: Total Assets 423,551.38m, Total Equity 17,146.71m, PAT -9,785.41m Solo) -- per project convention this was verified explicitly rather than assumed, since PREMIERBAN's interim basis has previously flipped between Solo (FY2019-2021, FY2023) and Consolidated (FY2022, FY2024, FY2025). PROOF: (1) this filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Assets 423,820.15m, Total Equity 16,767.82m) reproduces exactly against the FY2025 Consolidated Balance Sheet already on file, not the Solo figures; (2) the filing's own bottom-right 'Disclosure on Un-audited Financial Statements' box gives a direct Consolidated-vs-Solo 'Comparative Statement' for March 2026: NAV BDT 1,569.96 crore (Consolidated) vs BDT 1,613.46 crore (Solo), NAVPS 12.73 vs 13.08, EPS (0.87) vs (0.83), NOCFPS 25.82 vs 25.81 -- confirming the gap is real, small, and the main filing content (the four full statements) is Consolidated, matching the pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025. The Solo comparative figures above are recorded here only as cross-validation, not as this file's line_items, consistent with the main statements being the primary disclosure. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (column header 'January to March 2026'); for Q1 this is identical to the discrete quarter. Validated internally: Total Operating Income 738.96m - Total Operating Expenses 1,738.29m = Profit before provision -999.33m (exact); Total provision this quarter is nil, so PBT = -999.33m (exact); PBT - Tax 77.95m = PAT -1,077.28m (exact, matches reported PAT to the taka); Total Liabilities 454,033.70m + Total Equity 15,699.63m = Total Assets 469,733.33m (exact). The crisis documented in 2025_Q4.json continues into Q1 2026: Consolidated Net Interest Income is negative (-1,243.60m, interest expense of 6,971.41m exceeding interest income of 5,727.81m) and the bank posted a Consolidated net loss of -1,077.28m for the quarter, though smaller in magnitude than the worst discrete 2025 quarters (per 2025_Q3.json/2025_Q4.json period_notes, cumulative PAT fell from 278.56m at Q1-2025 to -9,925.90m by FY2025-end, implying much larger discrete losses in Q3/Q4 2025 than this quarter's -1,077.28m).
